latestVersion.changelog:
Animated Video — v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly turn uploaded images or text into animated explainer videos, with motion and transitions, using cloud AI.
- Supports PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 videos by default.
- Simple onboarding: auto-connects to backend and manages authentication for rapid first use.
- Review/edit session state, manage credits, and handle exports all via chat commands.
- Automatic error handling for token, credits, file issues, and clear export guidance.
- Designed for marketers needing quick animated videos without professional editing tools.
